Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows marked hyperinflation of the left lung with increased radiolucency and widened intercostal spaces, causing a mass effect that shifts the mediastinum to the right. This finding is characteristic of congenital lobar emphysema (hyperinflation), typically affecting the left upper lobe in infants, rather than fluid, solid mass, or collapse which would present differently.
